Heritage Square Update
Heritage Square is a diamond shaped garden ringed with flagpoles located immedi-
ately behind the International Office in Indianapolis, Indiana. The walkways are lined
with more than 900 engraved bricks recognizing donors to the Annual Fund .
Each chapter and alumni association has an opportunity to fly the flag of its school
or chapter through a contribution to the Annual Fund . At this time, 23 chapters, two
nations and one state are represented by flags. Any alumni association or alumnus
wishing further information on how to endow a flagpole can contact Mariann Williams,
Director of Development at 800-394 -1833 or via email at mariann @psiu .org .
